description: VAT category tax amount (BT-117=19.00) must equal VAT category taxable amount (BT-116=200.00) x (VAT rate (BT-119=7) / 100), rounded to two decimals.
The VAT category tax amount (BT-117=19.00) in a Standard rated (S) VAT breakdown must equal the VAT category taxable amount (BT-116=200.00) x (VAT rate (BT-119=7) / 100).
